Title: [Smoke] Standard user can log in and land on the Products page
Preconditions: The browser is open on https://www.saucedemo.com and no user is logged in.
Test Steps:
1) Type the username in the Username field
2) Type the password in the Password field
3) Click Login
Expected Result: The Products page opens at /inventory.html and the page header shows "Products".

Title: [Smoke] Products page shows the six products with name and price
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user, on the Products page.
Test Steps:
1) Look at the product list
2) Count the product cards
3) Read the name and price on each card
Expected Result: Six product cards are shown. Each card has a name, a description, a price and an "Add to cart" button. The first card is "Sauce Labs Backpack" at $29.99.

Title: [Smoke] Adding a product updates the cart count and the button becomes Remove
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user, on the Products page, cart is empty.
Test Steps:
1) Click "Add to cart" on the Sauce Labs Backpack card
2) Look at the cart icon in the top bar
3) Look at the button on the Backpack card
Expected Result: The cart icon shows the number 1 and the button on the Backpack card now reads "Remove".

Title: [Smoke] Cart page lists the products that were added
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Bike Light in the cart.
Test Steps:
1) Click the cart icon in the top bar
2) Read the rows in the cart list
Test Data: Sauce Labs Backpack ($29.99), Sauce Labs Bike Light ($9.99)
Expected Result: The Your Cart page opens at /cart.html and shows two rows: "Sauce Labs Backpack" $29.99 and "Sauce Labs Bike Light" $9.99, each with QTY 1.

Title: [Smoke] An order can be placed from cart to confirmation
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with at least one product in the cart, on the Your Cart page.
Test Steps:
1) Click Checkout
2) Fill in First Name, Last Name and Zip/Postal Code
3) Click Continue
4) Click Finish on the overview page
Test Data: First Name: QA-AUTO-Sherif | Last Name: Magdy | Zip: 11511
Expected Result: The confirmation page opens at /checkout-complete.html and shows "Thank you for your order!".

Title: Login is blocked when the username is empty
Preconditions: On the login page, no user is logged in.
Test Steps:
1) Leave the Username field empty
2) Leave the Password field empty
3) Click Login
Expected Result: The user stays on the login page and the message "Epic sadface: Username is required" is shown.

Title: Login is blocked when the password is empty
Preconditions: On the login page, no user is logged in.
Test Steps:
1) Type the username in the Username field
2) Leave the Password field empty
3) Click Login
Expected Result: The user stays on the login page and the message "Epic sadface: Password is required" is shown.

Title: A wrong password is rejected
Preconditions: On the login page, no user is logged in.
Test Steps:
1) Type a valid username
2) Type a password that is not the real one
3) Click Login
Expected Result: The user stays on the login page and the message "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service" is shown.

Title: A locked out user cannot log in
Preconditions: On the login page. The account locked_out_user exists and is locked.
Test Steps:
1) Type the locked out username
2) Type the correct password
3) Click Login
Expected Result: The user stays on the login page and the message "Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out." is shown.

Title: Logout returns the user to the login page
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user on any page inside the application.
Test Steps:
1) Click the menu button in the top left
2) Click Logout
Expected Result: The login page opens at / and the Username, Password and Login controls are shown again.

Title: The Products page cannot be opened by URL while logged out
Preconditions: No user is logged in. The browser is on the login page.
Test Steps:
1) Type https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html in the address bar
2) Press Enter
Expected Result: The login page is shown instead of the products, with the message "Epic sadface: You can only access '/inventory.html' when you are logged in."

Title: The browser Back button after logout does not show the previous page
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user and currently on the order confirmation page.
Test Steps:
1) Open the menu and click Logout
2) Click the browser Back button
Expected Result: The login page stays on screen with the message "Epic sadface: You can only access '/checkout-complete.html' when you are logged in." The previous page content is not shown.

Title: Removing the last product from the cart empties it and hides the cart count
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with exactly one product in the cart, on the Your Cart page.
Test Steps:
1) Click Remove on the product row
2) Look at the cart list and the cart icon
Expected Result: The product row disappears, no product rows are left in the cart, and the number on the cart icon is gone.

Title: The cart is empty after an order is completed
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user and an order has just been completed.
Test Steps:
1) Look at the cart icon on the confirmation page
2) Click "Back Home"
3) Click the cart icon
Expected Result: The cart icon shows no number and the Your Cart page shows no product rows.

Title: Checkout is blocked when First Name is empty
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with a product in the cart, on the checkout information page.
Test Steps:
1) Leave all three fields empty
2) Click Continue
Expected Result: The page stays on /checkout-step-one.html and the message "Error: First Name is required" is shown.

Title: Checkout is blocked when Last Name is empty
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with a product in the cart, on the checkout information page.
Test Steps:
1) Fill in First Name only
2) Leave Last Name and Zip/Postal Code empty
3) Click Continue
Expected Result: The page stays on /checkout-step-one.html and the message "Error: Last Name is required" is shown.

Title: Checkout is blocked when Zip/Postal Code is empty
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with a product in the cart, on the checkout information page.
Test Steps:
1) Fill in First Name and Last Name
2) Leave Zip/Postal Code empty
3) Click Continue
Test Data: First Name: QA-AUTO-Sherif | Last Name: Magdy
Expected Result: The page stays on /checkout-step-one.html and the message "Error: Postal Code is required" is shown.

Title: An order cannot be placed when the cart is empty
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with an empty cart, on the Your Cart page.
Test Steps:
1) Click Checkout
2) Fill in First Name, Last Name and Zip/Postal Code
3) Click Continue
Test Data: First Name: QA-AUTO-Empty | Last Name: Cart | Zip: 11511
Expected Result: The application stops the user from going further with an empty cart and does not reach the order overview page.

Title: The order total is the item total plus tax
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Bike Light in the cart.
Test Steps:
1) Click Checkout on the Your Cart page
2) Fill in the three fields and click Continue
3) Read the Item total, Tax and Total lines on the overview page
Test Data: Backpack $29.99 + Bike Light $9.99 | First Name: QA-AUTO-Sherif | Last Name: Magdy | Zip: 11511
Expected Result: The overview shows "Item total: $39.98", "Tax: $3.20" and "Total: $43.18".

Title: Sorting by Price (low to high) puts the cheapest product first
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user, on the Products page.
Test Steps:
1) Open the "Sort products" dropdown
2) Choose "Price (low to high)"
3) Read the prices from the first card to the last
Expected Result: The products are ordered $7.99, $9.99, $15.99, $15.99, $29.99, $49.99, with "Sauce Labs Onesie" first and "Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket" last.

Title: The chosen sort order stays after the page is refreshed
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user on the Products page with sorting set to Price (low to high).
Test Steps:
1) Refresh the page
2) Read the value shown in the sort dropdown
3) Read the order of the products
Expected Result: The sort dropdown still shows "Price (low to high)" and the cheapest product is still first.

Title: The product details page shows the name, price and description of the product opened
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user, on the Products page.
Test Steps:
1) Click the product name "Sauce Labs Backpack"
2) Read the name, description and price on the page
Expected Result: The page opens at /inventory-item.html?id=4 and shows "Sauce Labs Backpack", its description and the price $29.99, with a Back to products button.

Title: Products stay in the cart after the page is refreshed
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with two products in the cart, on the Products page.
Test Steps:
1) Refresh the page
2) Look at the number on the cart icon
Test Data: Sauce Labs Backpack, Sauce Labs Bike Light
Expected Result: The cart icon still shows the number 2.

Title: A Zip/Postal Code made only of spaces is rejected
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with a product in the cart, on the checkout information page.
Test Steps:
1) Fill in First Name and Last Name
2) Type three spaces in the Zip/Postal Code field
3) Click Continue
Test Data: First Name: QA-AUTO-Sherif | Last Name: Magdy | Zip: "   " (three spaces)
Expected Result: The page stays on /checkout-step-one.html and the message "Error: Postal Code is required" is shown.

Title: The cart icon label is written correctly when there is one product
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with exactly one product in the cart.
Test Steps:
1) Move the focus to the cart icon in the top bar
2) Read the name the screen reader announces for the icon
Expected Result: The cart icon is announced as "Cart, 1 item" — singular, not "1 items".

Title: The Dynamic Catalog menu item closes the menu and opens its own page
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user, on the Products page.
Test Steps:
1) Click the menu button in the top left
2) Click "Dynamic Catalog"
3) Look at the menu and at the page that opens
Expected Result: The side menu closes and a catalog page opens that is different from the All Items list.

Title: An empty cart shows a message telling the user it is empty
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with an empty cart.
Test Steps:
1) Click the cart icon
2) Read the content of the cart area
Expected Result: The Your Cart page shows a clear message such as "Your cart is empty" instead of only the QTY and Description headers.

Title: The checkout fields have a real label, not only placeholder text
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user with a product in the cart, on the checkout information page.
Test Steps:
1) Move the focus into the First Name field
2) Read the name announced for the field
3) Repeat for Last Name and Zip/Postal Code
Expected Result: Each of the three fields is announced with its own label ("First Name", "Last Name", "Zip/Postal Code") that stays visible after the user starts typing.
